title: Reorganize String
statement:
Given a string S, rearrange its characters so that no two adjacent characters are the same.

If it is possible, print any valid rearrangement. If it is impossible, print "IMPOSSIBLE".

A rearrangement is impossible if and only if the frequency of the most common character exceeds (|S| + 1) / 2.

Hint: use a max-heap to always place the most frequent remaining character, keeping a cooldown slot.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 500
S contains only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: A valid rearrangement with no two adjacent identical characters, or "IMPOSSIBLE".

examples.explanation: 'aba' has no two adjacent identical characters.
'a' appears 3 times in a string of length 4. 3 > (4+1)/2 = 2.5, so impossible.
